name: railsui_charts
description: Rails-native chart and metric components built on ApexCharts.

components.name: railsui_chart
components.description: Renders an ApexCharts chart from Ruby data.

inputs.data: Array of values, [x, y] pairs, or {x, y} hashes
inputs.label: Optional series name
inputs.colors: Optional array of CSS variable keys or color strings

components.name: railsui_metric
components.description: Renders a metric value with optional change indicator and sparkline.

inputs.label: Metric label
inputs.history: Optional array of values for the sparkline

examples: railsui_metric label: 'Monthly revenue', value: 48290, change: 12.4, format: :currency, history: @monthly_revenue

extension_points: Subclass RailsuiCharts::ApexOptionsBuilder to customize default options
